title: 2006 HMMT February Geometry Problem 2
statement: Suppose \(A B C\) is a scalene right triangle, and \(P\) is the point on hypotenuse \(\overline{A C}\) such that \(\angle A B P=45^{\circ}\). Given that \(A P=1\) and \(C P=2\), compute the area of \(A B C\).

solutions.text: Notice that \(\overline{B P}\) bisects the right angle at \(B\). Thus, we write \(A B=2 x\), \(B C=x\). By the Pythagorean theorem, \(5 x^{2}=9\), from which the area \(\frac{1}{2}(x)(2 x)=x^{2}=\) \(\frac{9}{5}\).
